levels.surface: هارون بن زيد بن أبي الزرقاء

notes: «حدثنا أبي» : Harun's father is not named in the text, so he is a bare relation link
«أنه بلغه عن الزهري» : the report reached Ja'far from Zuhri, who is named, so this is not an unnamed gap (rule 8)
«بهذا الحديث» points to a matn written elsewhere, not a transmitter: left out
the text carries no saying, only the chain
